purpose: Build fresh fail-closed target-horizon event-state evidence from free official calendars without creating directional votes; use OMB PFEI as a federal-official BLS schedule fallback when BLS HTTP transport is blocked.

bls_schedule_transport.primary_role: BLS direct monthly schedule when HTTP 200 and parser-valid
bls_schedule_transport.fallback_publisher: Executive Office of the President / Office of Management and Budget / Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs
bls_schedule_transport.fallback_role: Federal-official PFEI date schedule for Employment Situation, Producer Price Indexes, and Consumer Price Index when BLS direct HTTP transport is blocked
bls_schedule_transport.time_rule: 08:30 America/New_York for the three frozen BLS high-impact families; verified from the official BLS by-news-release schedules before the first real forecast
bls_schedule_transport.unsupported_year_rule: UNKNOWN unless BLS direct transport succeeds

source_failure_rule: If no known high event is already found and any required source is unavailable or parser-invalid, event_state=UNKNOWN.
known_high_event_rule: Any fixed high-impact event after request creation and no later than target close forces PRE_RELEASE_HIGH even if another source is unavailable.
post_event_rule: A fixed high-impact event with an exact official time earlier on the target day than request creation yields POST_EVENT_HIGH; a date-only event whose before/after status cannot be established forces UNKNOWN.

BOJ: Outlook for Economic Activity and Prices
Governor/Deputy Governor/Policy Board Member scheduled speech or meeting with local leaders is conservatively HIGH unless the official title explicitly establishes a non-policy administrative topic
JAPAN_STAT: Family Income and Expenditure Survey monthly household spending
FEDERAL_RESERVE: Chair/Governor/Vice Chair speech explicitly concerning economic outlook, inflation, interest rates, or monetary policy
